authorityAndBudget.account: Issue #1512 explicitly requires ACME_DEMO_EMAIL / ACME_DEMO_PASSWORD from existing prod:/; never include their values in evidence.
authorityAndBudget.workspace: Unique personal workspace and owner-only subscription/runtime are current driver guards, not an additional restriction stated by the issue. Do not silently substitute ordinary shared SMOKE acceptance or relax guards before a concrete preflight failure.
authorityAndBudget.models: AGENTS requires the two exact official subscription paths independently. No API-key/DeepSeek leg or provider/model switch; built-in Decision openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions is separate permitted system work and must be included in telemetry evidence if observed.
authorityAndBudget.ordering: Preflight first. Each browser execute is a separate single-model invocation (browser-submit with model-case=all is rejected). Let cleanup/restoration finish before the next case. A path-local provider block does not substitute for the other path; uncertain submission/cleanup is not a reason to resubmit.
authorityAndBudget.workflow: main-only; expected-deployment-sha exactly equals GITHUB_SHA; job budget25min; per-case default480000ms, allowed60000..600000ms. Current account/source/runtime gates remain Root's release responsibility.
authorityAndBudget.spending: At most one driver submission per case/revision, v2 native execute+review or legacy execute+review+verify; observed excess cancels, not an atomic provider/dollar cap.
